تتراوقوا (form VI)
# تَتَرَاوَقُوا (tatarāwaqū) /ta.ta.raː.wa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاوَقَ (tarāwaqa)
# تُتَرَاوَقُوا (tutarāwaqū) /tu.ta.raː.wa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاوَقَ (tarāwaqa)
